Description
Auburn University has more than 24,600 undergraduate students making Auburn the second largest university in Alabama. The 2020 edition of U.S. News & World Report ranks Auburn as tied for the 97th best national university overall in the U.S., tied for 40th among public universities, and 164th in "Best Value Schools".
